description: It's been a privilege representing the communities of Bozrah, Colchester, Franklin and Lebanon as your State Representative. I'm proud of our progress in Hartford, from tax relief for the middle class to advocating for Education Cost Sharing (ECS) funding and prioritizing safety in our District. Collaborating with the Department of Transportation, we've spearheaded initiatives like Wrong Way Detection Systems, with plans to implement them on off-ramps along Route 2 in Bozrah and Colchester. ​
title: Home | DeCaprio 4 CT 48th
